blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Sixteen loose firearms and an explosive device were surrendered to various police units across the Caraga Region on Saturday, Nov. 21, amid the government’s intensified crackdown on unlicensed weapons, the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) reported. PRO-13 director Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon said the surrendered cache included six .38-caliber revolvers, five .45-caliber pistols, two .22-caliber rifles, two improvised firearms, and one .357-caliber revolver. The Agusan del Sur Police Provincial Office (PPO) logged the highest number of turn-ins with nine firearms and the explosive device. It was followed by the Surigao del Norte PPO with three […]...
